steps.speaker: Boy
steps.text: I've kicked my ball over that hedge, into that garden! The old lady who lives there is scary... She's locked the ball in her wooden shed! Can you get my ball back for me please?
If the player is below level 10 combat:

steps.player: Ok, I'll see what I can do.

options.text: Well if you're not going to answer, I'll go.

steps.player: Well if you're not going to answer, I'll go.

getting-started-talking-to-him-again.speaker: Boy
getting-started-talking-to-him-again.text: Have you got my ball back yet?

getting-started-talking-to-him-again.speaker: Boy
getting-started-talking-to-him-again.text: Well, it's in the shed in that garden.

the-witch-s-house-searching-the-plant-po.text: You find a key hidden under the flower pot.

the-witch-s-house-attempting-to-play-the.text: You decide not to attract the attention of the witch by playing on the piano.

the-witch-s-house-attempting-to-search-t.text: You can't see anything of interest on the stand.

the-witch-s-house-attempting-to-open-the.player: Strange... I can't see any kind of lock or handle to open this door...

the-witch-s-house-attempting-to-open-the.text: As your bare hands touch the gate you feel a shock.

the-witch-s-house-searching-the-cupboard.text: You find a magnet in the cupboard.

the-witch-s-house-after-dropping-cheese-.text: A mouse runs out of the hole.

the-witch-s-house-using-a-magnet-on-the-.text: You attach the magnet to the mouse's harness. The mouse finishes the cheese and runs back into its hole. You hear some odd noises from inside the walls. There is a strange whirring noise from above the door frame.
This doesn't seem to be the right magnet to open this door...
You have already unlocked this door.

getting-past-the-witch-if-the-player-get.text: The witch casts a spell on the player and the player is teleported out of the witch's house next to the boy.

getting-past-the-witch-searching-the-fou.text: You search for the secret compartment mentioned in the diary. Inside it you find a small key. You take the key.
You already have the key that was in the secret compartment in this fountain.

getting-past-the-witch-attempting-to-ope.player: I'd better not go in there yet... I think I can hear someone inside!

the-ball-attempting-to-grab-the-ball-bef.text: The shapeshifter glares at you. You feel slightly weakened.

the-ball-attempting-to-grab-the-ball-aft.text: A shapeshifter appears, and knocks you back from the ball!

the-ball-killing-the-first-form.text: the shapeshifters' body begins to deform!
The shapeshifter turns into a spider!

the-ball-killing-the-second-form.text: The shapeshifters' body begins to twist!
The shapeshifter turns into a bear!

the-ball-killing-the-third-form.text: The shapeshifter turns into a wolf!

the-ball-killing-the-fourth-form.text: You finally kill the shapeshifter once and for all.

finishing-up.player: Hi, I have got your ball back. It was MUCH harder than I thought it would be.
